Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator misapplied the verb’s semantics and case roles. For “Maktay” (“is pleasing to”), the experiencer (“I”) should be the object (accusative “Mato”) and “apples” should be the subject (nominative “Apple”), in V-O-S order. Instead, it treated “apples” as the direct object (“Zapple”) and incorrectly put “Mato” as the subject (using an accusative form as subject), yielding “Maktay Zapple Mato” instead of the correct “Maktay Mato Apple.”
